preconditions.description: The number of flowers n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of suggested subarrays m must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(-100 <= a[i] <= 100 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each flower's mood must be between -100 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l[i] <= r[i] <= n for i in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each subarray must have valid indices within the range of flowers.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible happiness value as a string.
